answer: To register, an agent locks a work-escrow bond, released after verified service as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. An agent caught failing a sampled proof-of-work audit is exposed by audits sampled every epoch. The penalty follows at once: the identity freezes until a jury acquits and releases the bond. Every identity carries a hollow deposit, visible and slashable. No cedar hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. The relic bond is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
